concerns.text: The plan uses the ROCStories corpus as the narrative source but the fMRI dataset (OpenNeuro ds001495) contains a different set of story stimuli. The intersection of ROCStories with the fMRI stimulus log is expected to be very small (often < 10), causing the pipeline to abort (E002) and rendering the RSA analysis impossible. This constitutes a wrong‑dataset choice for the research question, which requires story stimuli that match the neural recordings.

The permutation test is defined to run 10 000 permutations, each recomputing RSA differences across three ROIs for up to 12 500 stories (≈ 156 M pairwise correlations per ROI). Even with 4‑core parallelism, this workload far exceeds the compute budget of the GitHub Actions free‑tier (2 CPU cores, ≤ 6 h). The expected runtime will likely surpass the allowed job time, making the analysis infeasible under the stated constraints.
